local SIZE_LEVELS = 6
local SPAN = 9.6

local FENCE_COLOURS = {
    [7]  = { post = Color3.fromRGB(104, 132, 196), rail = Color3.fromRGB(146, 182, 244) },
    [8]  = { post = Color3.fromRGB( 92, 168, 118), rail = Color3.fromRGB(136, 226, 158) },
    [9]  = { post = Color3.fromRGB(158, 108, 200), rail = Color3.fromRGB(206, 152, 250) },
    [10] = { post = Color3.fromRGB(206, 116,  64), rail = Color3.fromRGB(252, 168,  92) },
    [11] = { post = Color3.fromRGB(190,  58,  74), rail = Color3.fromRGB(248, 104, 118) },
    [12] = { post = Color3.fromRGB(168, 132,  30), rail = Color3.fromRGB(255, 214,  76),
             neon = true },
}

local MILL_COLOURS = {
    Color3.fromRGB( 72, 208, 240), Color3.fromRGB( 74, 162, 250),
    Color3.fromRGB(120, 130, 252), Color3.fromRGB(176, 110, 248),
    Color3.fromRGB(232, 100, 224), Color3.fromRGB(250, 88, 150),
    Color3.fromRGB(252, 96, 84),   Color3.fromRGB(254, 148, 52),
    Color3.fromRGB(252, 204, 48),  Color3.fromRGB(178, 230, 56),
    Color3.fromRGB( 68, 220, 122), Color3.fromRGB(255, 214, 76),
}

local function fenceParts(pen)
    local sign = pen:FindFirstChild("Sign")
    local list = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(pen:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and not (sign and p:IsDescendantOf(sign)) then
            list[#list + 1] = p
        end
    end
    return list
end

local function bounds(parts)
    local lo = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
    local hi = Vector3.new(-1e9, -1e9, -1e9)
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        lo = lo:Min(p.Position - p.Size / 2)
        hi = hi:Max(p.Position + p.Size / 2)
    end
    return lo, hi
end

local function sideOf(p, lo, hi)
    local midX, midZ = (lo.X + hi.X) / 2, (lo.Z + hi.Z) / 2
    local nx = math.abs(p.Position.X - midX) / math.max(0.01, (hi.X - lo.X) / 2)
    local nz = math.abs(p.Position.Z - midZ) / math.max(0.01, (hi.Z - lo.Z) / 2)
    if nx > nz then
        return p.Position.X < midX and "W" or "E"
    end
    return p.Position.Z < midZ and "S" or "N"
end

local function findEntrance(parts, lo, hi)
    local bySide = { W = {}, E = {}, S = {}, N = {} }
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        table.insert(bySide[sideOf(p, lo, hi)], p)
    end
    local best, bestGap = nil, 0
    for key, list in pairs(bySide) do
        local along = (key == "S" or key == "N") and "X" or "Z"
        local coords = {}
        for _, p in ipairs(list) do coords[#coords + 1] = p.Position[along] end
        table.sort(coords)
        for i = 2, #coords do
            local d = coords[i] - coords[i - 1]
            if d > bestGap then bestGap = d best = key end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local plots = {}

local function describe(pen)
    local parts = fenceParts(pen)
    if #parts == 0 then return end
    local lo, hi = bounds(parts)
    local front = findEntrance(parts, lo, hi) or "S"

    local axis = (front == "S" or front == "N") and "Z" or "X"
    local dir = (front == "S" or front == "W") and 1 or -1

    local base = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        base[p] = { cf = p.CFrame, colour = p.Color, material = p.Material }
    end

    plots[pen] = {
        pen = pen, axis = axis, dir = dir, front = front,
        base = base, grown = 0, tinted = false,
    }
    pen:SetAttribute("GrowAxis", axis)
    pen:SetAttribute("Entrance", front)
end

local function alongOf(rec, p)
    return p.Position[rec.axis] * rec.dir
end

local function backRow(rec, parts)
    local back
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        if p.Size.Y > 4 then
            local c = alongOf(rec, p)
            if not back or c > back then back = c end
        end
    end
    return back
end

local function grow(rec)
    local parts = fenceParts(rec.pen)
    local back = backRow(rec, parts)
    if not back then return false end

    local shift = (rec.axis == "Z") and Vector3.new(0, 0, SPAN * rec.dir)
                                     or Vector3.new(SPAN * rec.dir, 0, 0)
    local edge = back - SPAN / 2 + 0.05

    local toClone = {}
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        local c = alongOf(rec, p)
        if c > edge then
            p.CFrame = p.CFrame + shift
        elseif c >= back - SPAN - 0.05 then
            toClone[#toClone + 1] = p
        end
    end

    rec.grown += 1
    for _, p in ipairs(toClone) do
        local c = p:Clone()
        c.CFrame = p.CFrame + shift
        c:SetAttribute("GrownStep", rec.grown)
        c.Parent = p.Parent
    end
    return true
end

local function shrink(rec)
    if rec.grown <= 0 then return false end
    local step = rec.grown
    for _, p in ipairs(fenceParts(rec.pen)) do
        if p:GetAttribute("GrownStep") == step then p:Destroy() end
    end

    local parts = fenceParts(rec.pen)
    local back = backRow(rec, parts)
    if not back then return false end
    local shift = (rec.axis == "Z") and Vector3.new(0, 0, -SPAN * rec.dir)
                                     or Vector3.new(-SPAN * rec.dir, 0, 0)
    local edge = back - SPAN / 2 + 0.05
    for _, p in ipairs(parts) do
        if alongOf(rec, p) > edge then p.CFrame = p.CFrame + shift end
    end
    rec.grown -= 1
    return true
end

local function tint(rec, level)
    local scheme = FENCE_COLOURS[level]
    for _, p in ipairs(fenceParts(rec.pen)) do
        local isPost = p.Size.Y > 4
        if scheme then
            p.Color = isPost and scheme.post or scheme.rail
            p.Material = scheme.neon and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        else
            local b = rec.base[p]

            if b then
                p.Color = b.colour
                p.Material = b.material
            end
        end
    end
    rec.tinted = scheme ~= nil
end

local function applyPlot(pen)
    local rec = plots[pen]
    if not rec then return end
    local level = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(pen:GetAttribute("PlotLevel")) or 1), 1, MAX_LEVEL)
    local wantGrown = math.min(level, SIZE_LEVELS) - 1
    while rec.grown < wantGrown do
        if not grow(rec) then break end
    end
    while rec.grown > wantGrown do
        if not shrink(rec) then break end
    end
    tint(rec, level)
    pen:SetAttribute("AnimalCap", UpgradeCfg.petCap(level))
end

local function showSurfaces(part, visible)
    for _, t in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
        if t:IsA("Texture") or t:IsA("Decal") then
            local base = t:GetAttribute("MillTextureTransparency")
            if base == nil then base = t.Transparency t:SetAttribute("MillTextureTransparency", base) end
            t.Transparency = visible and base or 1
        end
    end
end

local function applyMill(mill)
    local level = math.clamp(math.floor(tonumber(mill:GetAttribute("MillLevel")) or 1), 1, MAX_LEVEL)
    local colour = MILL_COLOURS[level] or MILL_COLOURS[1]
    local sign = mill:FindFirstChild("Sign")
    local wood = mill:FindFirstChild("WoodLevelOne")
    for _, p in ipairs(mill:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and not (sign and p:IsDescendantOf(sign)) then

            if wood and p:IsDescendantOf(wood) then
                p.Transparency = level == 1 and 0 or 1
                showSurfaces(p, level == 1)
                continue
            end
            local original = p:GetAttribute("MillOriginalTransparency")
            if original ~= nil then p.Transparency = level == 1 and 1 or original end
            showSurfaces(p, p.Transparency < 1)
            local keep = p.Name == "belt" or p.Name == "ArrowPad" or p.Name:find("belt")
            if not keep then p.Color = colour end
        end
    end
end

for _, pen in ipairs(pens:GetChildren()) do
    describe(pen)
    applyPlot(pen)
    pen:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PlotLevel"):Connect(function() applyPlot(pen) end)
end

for _, mill in ipairs(mills:GetChildren()) do
    applyMill(mill)
    mill:GetAttributeChangedSignal("MillLevel"):Connect(function() applyMill(mill) end)
end

local EXTRA_H = 320
local SHOW = false

require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("EggConfig"))

local old = map:FindFirstChild("Barriers")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
folder.Name = "Barriers"
folder.Parent = map

local made = 0
for _, part in ipairs(walls:GetDescendants()) do
    if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then

        local cf, sz = part.CFrame, part.Size
        local top = cf.Position.Y
            + math.abs(cf.RightVector.Y) * sz.X / 2
            + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Y)    * sz.Y / 2
            + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Y)  * sz.Z / 2
        local spanX = math.abs(cf.RightVector.X) * sz.X
            + math.abs(cf.UpVector.X) * sz.Y + math.abs(cf.LookVector.X) * sz.Z
        local spanZ = math.abs(cf.RightVector.Z) * sz.X
            + math.abs(cf.UpVector.Z) * sz.Y + math.abs(cf.LookVector.Z) * sz.Z

        local wall = Instance.new("Part")
        wall.Name = "Barrier"
        wall.Anchored = true
        wall.CanCollide = true
        wall.CanTouch = false
        wall.CanQuery = false
        wall.CastShadow = false
        wall.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
        wall.Color = Color3.fromRGB(120, 200, 255)
        wall.Transparency = SHOW and 0.75 or 1
        wall.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(spanX, 1), EXTRA_H, math.max(spanZ, 1))
        wall.Position = Vector3.new(cf.Position.X, top + EXTRA_H / 2, cf.Position.Z)
        wall.Parent = folder
        made += 1
    end
end

local FENCE_INSET = 5
local MIN_GAP = 4
local DISPLAY_H = 2.6
local PROMPT_RANGE = 14

local rects = {}
local function measure(pen)
    local sign = pen:FindFirstChild("Sign")
    local lo = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
    local hi = Vector3.new(-1e9, -1e9, -1e9)
    for _, p in ipairs(pen:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and not (sign and p:IsDescendantOf(sign)) then
            lo = lo:Min(p.Position - p.Size / 2)
            hi = hi:Max(p.Position + p.Size / 2)
        end
    end
    rects[pen] = {
        minX = lo.X + FENCE_INSET, maxX = hi.X - FENCE_INSET,
        minZ = lo.Z + FENCE_INSET, maxZ = hi.Z - FENCE_INSET,
        floorY = lo.Y,
    }
end
for _, pen in ipairs(pens:GetChildren()) do
    measure(pen)
    pen:GetAttributeChangedSignal("PlotLevel"):Connect(function()
        task.defer(measure, pen)
        task.delay(0.5, measure, pen)
    end)
end

local lastMeasure = 0
local function penAt(pos)
    if os.clock() - lastMeasure > 2 then
        lastMeasure = os.clock()
        for _, pen in ipairs(pens:GetChildren()) do measure(pen) end
    end
    for pen, r in pairs(rects) do
        if pos.X >= r.minX and pos.X <= r.maxX and pos.Z >= r.minZ and pos.Z <= r.maxZ then
            return pen, r
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function penOf(plr)
    for _, pen in ipairs(pens:GetChildren()) do
        if pen:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") == plr.UserId then return pen end
    end
    return nil
end

local function penFrame(pen)
    local r = rects[pen]
    if not r then return nil end
    return (r.minX + r.maxX) / 2, (r.minZ + r.maxZ) / 2,
           (r.maxX - r.minX) / 2, (r.maxZ - r.minZ) / 2
end

local function eggListOf(plr)

    local prof = Profile and Profile.get(plr)
    if not prof then return nil end
    if type(prof.NestEggs) ~= "table" then prof.NestEggs = {} end
    return prof.NestEggs
end

local function takeFromInventory(plr, zone, tier, size, species, luck)
    local Profile = _G.Profile
    local prof = Profile and Profile.get(plr)
    local inv = prof and prof.Eggs
    if type(inv) ~= "table" then return end
    for i = #inv, 1, -1 do
        local e = inv[i]

        if e.z == zone and e.t == tier and e.s == size and e.sp == species and e.lk == luck then
            table.remove(inv, i)
            return true
        end
    end
end

local function rememberEgg(plr, pen, pos, zone, tier, size, readyAt, species, luck)
    local list = eggListOf(plr)
    if not list then return end
    local cx, cz, hx, hz = penFrame(pen)
    if not cx then return end
    local key = newKey()
    list[#list + 1] = {
        key = key,
        zone = zone, tier = tier, size = size, ready = readyAt,
        species = species, luck = luck,
        u = math.clamp((pos.X - cx) / math.max(1, hx), -0.95, 0.95),
        v = math.clamp((pos.Z - cz) / math.max(1, hz), -0.95, 0.95),
    }
    return key
end

local function eggRecordOf(list, model)
    if not list or not model then return nil end
    local key = model:GetAttribute("EggKey")
    if key then
        for i, e in ipairs(list) do
            if e.key == key then return e, i end
        end
        return nil
    end
    local zone, tier, size = model:GetAttribute("EggZone"), model:GetAttribute("EggTier"), model:GetAttribute("EggSize")
    local epoch = tonumber(model:GetAttribute("ReadyEpoch")) or 0
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        local e = list[i]
        if e.zone == zone and e.tier == tier and e.size == size and math.abs((e.ready or 0) - epoch) < 2 then
            return e, i
        end
    end
    return nil
end

local function forgetByKey(list, key)
    if not (list and key and key ~= "") then return false end
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        if list[i].key == key then
            table.remove(list, i)
            return true
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function forgetEgg(plr, zone, tier, size, readyAt, key)
    local list = eggListOf(plr)
    if not list then return end
    if key then
        for i = #list, 1, -1 do
            if list[i].key == key then
                table.remove(list, i)
                return
            end
        end
        return
    end
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        local e = list[i]
        if e.zone == zone and e.tier == tier and e.size == size
           and math.abs((e.ready or 0) - readyAt) < 2 then
            table.remove(list, i)
            return
        end
    end
end

local function deny(plr, text)

local function heldEgg(plr)
    local ch = plr.Character
    if not ch then return nil end
    for _, t in ipairs(ch:GetChildren()) do
        if t:IsA("Tool") and t:GetAttribute("EggZone") then return t end
    end
    return nil
end

local function buildDisplay(tool, size)
    local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
    if not handle then return nil end

    local model = Instance.new("Model")
    local root
    for _, p in ipairs(tool:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local c = p:Clone()
            c:ClearAllChildren()
            c.Anchored = true
            c.CanCollide = false
            c.CanQuery = (p == handle)
            c.Massless = true
            c.CastShadow = false

            c.CFrame = handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)
            c.Parent = model
            if p == handle then root = c end
        end
    end
    if not root then model:Destroy() return nil end
    model.PrimaryPart = root

    local scale = Cfg.SIZES[size] and Cfg.SIZES[size].scale or 1
    local _, box = model:GetBoundingBox()
    if box.Y > 0.001 then
        model:ScaleTo(model:GetScale() * (DISPLAY_H * math.sqrt(scale) / box.Y))
    end
    return model
end

local function tooClose(pos)
    for _, egg in ipairs(placed:GetChildren()) do
        local pp = egg.PrimaryPart
        if pp then
            local d = (Vector3.new(pp.Position.X, 0, pp.Position.Z) - Vector3.new(pos.X, 0, pos.Z)).Magnitude
            if d < MIN_GAP then return true end
        end
    end
    return false
end

local hatchPrompt

local function placeEgg(plr, pos)
    if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return end

    local tool = heldEgg(plr)
    if not tool then
        deny(plr, "Hold an egg first")
        return
    end

    local pen = penAt(pos)
    if not pen then
        deny(plr, "You can only place eggs on your own plot")
        return
    end
    if pen:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId") ~= plr.UserId then
        deny(plr, "This isn't your plot")
        return
    end
    if tooClose(pos) then
        deny(plr, "Too close to another egg")
        return
    end

    local zone = tool:GetAttribute("EggZone") or 1
    local tier = tool:GetAttribute("EggTier") or 1
    local size = tool:GetAttribute("EggSize") or 1
    local species = tool:GetAttribute("EggSpecies")
    local luck = tool:GetAttribute("EggLuck")

    local model = buildDisplay(tool, size)
    if not model then return end
    model.Name = tool.Name

    local r = rects[pen]
    local _, box = model:GetBoundingBox()
    local ground = r and r.floorY or pos.Y
    model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(pos.X, ground + box.Y / 2, pos.Z))
    model.Parent = placed

    model:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", plr.UserId)
    model:SetAttribute("EggZone", zone)
    model:SetAttribute("EggTier", tier)
    model:SetAttribute("EggSize", size)
    if species then model:SetAttribute("EggSpecies", species) end
    if luck then model:SetAttribute("EggLuck", luck) end
    model:SetAttribute("Ready", false)

    local growth = math.max(1, tonumber(plr:GetAttribute("GrowthMult")) or 1)
        * (_G.GlobalBoost and _G.GlobalBoost.value("hatch") or 1)
    local wait = Cfg.hatchTime(zone, size, tier) / growth
    model:SetAttribute("HatchAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + wait)
    model:SetAttribute("HatchTotal", wait)

    local readyAt = os.time() + wait
    model:SetAttribute("ReadyEpoch", readyAt)
    model:SetAttribute("EggKey", rememberEgg(plr, pen, pos, zone, tier, size, readyAt, species, luck))
    takeFromInventory(plr, zone, tier, size, species, luck)

    hatchPrompt(model)
    tool:Destroy()
end

local eggAssets = game:GetService("ServerStorage"):FindFirstChild("EggAssets")
local eggSet = eggAssets and eggAssets:FindFirstChild("Eggs")

local function eggTemplate(zone)
    if not eggSet then return nil end
    return eggSet:FindFirstChild("Zone" .. zone) or eggSet:FindFirstChild("Default")
end

local AnimalEggs = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("AnimalEggs"))

local function buildFromTemplate(zone, tier, size, species)
    local speciesTpl = AnimalEggs.template(species)
    local tpl = speciesTpl or eggTemplate(zone)
    if not tpl then return nil end
    local m = tpl:Clone()

    local colour = Cfg.eggColor(zone, tier)
    local accent = Color3.new(colour.R * 0.68, colour.G * 0.68, colour.B * 0.68)
    local glow = Cfg.GLOW[tier] or Cfg.GLOW[1]
    local root
    for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            local isShell = p.Name:lower():match("^shell") ~= nil
            if not speciesTpl then
                p.Color = isShell and colour or (glow.deco and colour or accent)
                p.Material = ((isShell and glow.shell) or (not isShell and glow.deco))
                    and Enum.Material.Neon or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
            end
            p.Anchored = true
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.CanQuery = isShell
            p.Massless = true
            p.CastShadow = false
            if isShell and not root then root = p end
        end
    end
    if not root then
        for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
            if p:IsA("BasePart") then root = p break end
        end
    end
    if not root then m:Destroy() return nil end
    m.PrimaryPart = root

    local scale = Cfg.SIZES[size] and Cfg.SIZES[size].scale or 1
    local _, box = m:GetBoundingBox()
    if box.Y > 0.001 then
        m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * (DISPLAY_H * math.sqrt(scale) / box.Y))
    end
    return m
end

local function restoreEggs(plr)
    local list = eggListOf(plr)
    if not list or #list == 0 then return 0 end
    local pen = penOf(plr)
    if not pen then return 0 end
    local cx, cz, hx, hz = penFrame(pen)
    if not cx then return 0 end
    local r = rects[pen]
    local now = os.time()
    local built = 0

    for _, e in ipairs(list) do
        if e.species == nil then e.species = AnimalEggs.legacy(e.zone or 1, e.tier or 1, e.size or 1) end
        local m = buildFromTemplate(e.zone or 1, e.tier or 1, e.size or 1, e.species)
        if m then
            e.key = e.key or newKey()
            m:SetAttribute("EggKey", e.key)
            m.Name = ("%s %s %s Egg"):format(
                e.species or Cfg.NAMES[e.zone] or ("Zone" .. tostring(e.zone)),
                Cfg.TIERS[e.tier] and Cfg.TIERS[e.tier].name or "Common",
                Cfg.SIZES[e.size] and Cfg.SIZES[e.size].name or "Normal")
            local x = cx + (e.u or 0) * hx
            local z = cz + (e.v or 0) * hz
            local _, box = m:GetBoundingBox()
            m:PivotTo(CFrame.new(x, (r and r.floorY or 0) + box.Y / 2, z))
            m.Parent = placed

            m:SetAttribute("OwnerUserId", plr.UserId)
            m:SetAttribute("EggZone", e.zone)
            m:SetAttribute("EggTier", e.tier)
            m:SetAttribute("EggSize", e.size)
            if e.species then m:SetAttribute("EggSpecies", e.species) end
            if e.luck then m:SetAttribute("EggLuck", e.luck) end
            m:SetAttribute("ReadyEpoch", e.ready or now)

            local left = math.max(0, (e.ready or now) - now)
            m:SetAttribute("HatchAt", workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + left)
            m:SetAttribute("HatchTotal", math.max(left, Cfg.hatchTime(e.zone or 1, e.size or 1, e.tier or 1)))
            m:SetAttribute("Ready", false)
            hatchPrompt(m)
            built += 1
        end
    end
    return built
end

        local list = folder:GetChildren()

local function grantAnimal(plr, zone, tier, size, opts)
    opts = opts or {}
    local m = animalTemplate(zone, tier, size, opts.species)
    if not m then return nil end

    m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * ((Cfg.ANIMAL_SCALE and Cfg.ANIMAL_SCALE[size]) or 1))
    local ownPen = penOf(plr)
    local r = ownPen and rects[ownPen]
    if r then
        local _, box = m:GetBoundingBox()
        local longest = math.max(box.X, box.Z)
        local room = math.min(r.maxX - r.minX, r.maxZ - r.minZ) * (Cfg.ANIMAL_PEN_FILL or 0.8)
        if longest > room and longest > 0.01 then
            m:ScaleTo(m:GetScale() * (room / longest))
        end
    end

    if not opts.restoring and _G.PetIndex and _G.PetIndex.discover then
        pcall(_G.PetIndex.discover, plr, zone,
            speciesSlot(zone, opts.species) or animalIndex(size or 1, tier or 1))
    end

    local handle = m:FindFirstChild("Handle")
        or m:FindFirstChild(tostring(m:GetAttribute("RootPart")))
        or m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
    if not handle then m:Destroy() return nil end
    local pivotOffset = handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(m:GetPivot())

    local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
    tool.Name = ("%s %s %s"):format(
        Cfg.NAMES[zone] or ("Zone" .. zone), Cfg.TIERS[tier].name, Cfg.SIZES[size].name)
    tool.RequiresHandle = true
    tool.CanBeDropped = false
    tool:SetAttribute("AnimalZone", zone)
    tool:SetAttribute("AnimalTier", tier)
    tool:SetAttribute("AnimalSize", size)
    tool:SetAttribute("Species", m:GetAttribute("Species") or tool.Name)
    if opts.luck then tool:SetAttribute("Luck", opts.luck) end

    for _, p in ipairs(m:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p.Anchored = false
            p.CanCollide = false
            p.Massless = true
        end
    end
    handle.Name = "Handle"

    handle:SetAttribute("RestOffset", CFrame.new())
    handle:SetAttribute("PivotOffset", pivotOffset)
    handle.Parent = tool
    for _, p in ipairs(m:GetChildren()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") then
            p:SetAttribute("RestOffset", handle.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame))
            local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
            w.Part0 = handle
            w.Part1 = p
            w.Parent = handle
            p.Parent = tool
        end
    end
    m:Destroy()

    local key = opts.key or newKey()
    tool:SetAttribute("SaveKey", key)
    if not opts.restoring then
        local inv = petInventoryOf(plr)
        if inv then
            inv[#inv + 1] = { key = key, zone = zone, tier = tier, size = size,
                species = tool:GetAttribute("Species"), luck = opts.luck }
        end
    end

    tool.Parent = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack") or plr.Backpack
    return tool
end

local function wobble(model, seconds)
    if not model.PrimaryPart then return end
    local base = model:GetPivot()
    local t0 = os.clock()
    local last = t0
    local phase = 0
    while os.clock() - t0 < seconds do
        if not model.Parent then return end
        local now = os.clock()
        local k = (now - t0) / seconds
        local rate = 16 + 30 * k
        phase += rate * (now - last)
        last = now
        local tilt = math.sin(phase) * math.rad(5 + 18 * k)
        local hop = math.abs(math.sin(phase * 0.5)) * 0.22 * k
        model:PivotTo(base * CFrame.new(0, hop, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, tilt))
        task.wait()
    end
    if model.Parent then model:PivotTo(base) end
end

local function rewardFor(zone)
	local money = math.floor(Cfg.animalIncome(zone, IDX.MONEY_SIZE or 3, IDX.MONEY_TIER or 2) * (IDX.MONEY_SECONDS or 120))
	local nextNeed = Cfg.POWER_N and Cfg.POWER_N[zone + 1]
	local speed
	if nextNeed then
		speed = nextNeed * (IDX.SPEED_NEXT_ZONE_SHARE or 0.5)
	else
		speed = ((Cfg.POWER_N and Cfg.POWER_N[zone]) or 1) * (IDX.SPEED_LAST_ZONE_MULT or 2)
	end
	speed = math.floor(math.min(math.max(speed, 1), Cfg.SPEED_MAX))
	return money, speed
end

local function slotReward(zone, slot)
	local money, speed = rewardFor(zone)
	local TIER_MULT = { 1, 1.5, 3, 5 }
	local k = (TIER_MULT[tierFor(zone, slot)] or 1) / (IDX.SLOT_DIVISOR or 4)
	return math.max(1, math.floor(money * k)), math.max(1, math.floor(speed * k))
end

local function buildState(plr)
	local prof = profileOf(plr)
	if not prof then return nil end
	local found = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(prof.PetIndex) do found[k] = true end
	local took = {}
	for _, k in ipairs(prof.IndexClaimed) do
		if type(k) == "string" then took[k] = true end
	end

	local zones, total, readyAll = {}, 0, 0
	for zone = 1, ZONES do
		local names = speciesNames(zone)
		local slots, count, ready = {}, 0, 0
		for slot = 1, PER_ZONE do
			local info = slotInfo(zone, slot)
			local got = found[key(zone, slot)] == true
			local claimed = took[key(zone, slot)] == true
			if got then count += 1 end
			if got and not claimed then ready += 1 end
			local money, speed = slotReward(zone, slot)
			slots[slot] = {
				name = names[slot] or "?",
				found = got,
				claimed = claimed,
				tier = info.tier,
				rarity = info.rarity,
				source = info.source,
				income = info.income,
				money = money,
				speed = speed,
			}
		end
		total += count
		readyAll += ready
		zones[zone] = {
			name = Cfg.NAMES[zone] or ("Zone " .. zone),
			slots = slots,
			count = count,
			ready = ready,
		}
	end
	return { zones = zones, total = total, max = ZONES * PER_ZONE, ready = readyAll, equippedBat = Bats.equipped(plr) }
end

	return true
end

local beltOf = {}
for _, plot in ipairs(plots) do
    local belt = plot.mill:FindFirstChild("belt", true)
    local sign = plot.mill:FindFirstChild("Sign")

    local pivot = plot.mill:GetPivot()
    local lo = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
    local hi = Vector3.new(-1e9, -1e9, -1e9)
    for _, p in ipairs(plot.mill:GetDescendants()) do
        if p:IsA("BasePart") and not (sign and p:IsDescendantOf(sign)) and p.Name ~= "ArrowPad" then
            local rel = pivot:PointToObjectSpace(p.Position)
            local half = p.Size / 2
            lo = Vector3.new(math.min(lo.X, rel.X - half.X), math.min(lo.Y, rel.Y - half.Y), math.min(lo.Z, rel.Z - half.Z))
            hi = Vector3.new(math.max(hi.X, rel.X + half.X), math.max(hi.Y, rel.Y + half.Y), math.max(hi.Z, rel.Z + half.Z))
        end
    end
    local mid = (lo + hi) / 2

    beltOf[plot.index] = {
        cf = pivot * CFrame.new(mid.X, belt and pivot:PointToObjectSpace(belt.Position).Y or mid.Y, mid.Z),
        size = hi - lo,

        beltCf = belt and belt.CFrame or nil,
        beltSize = belt and belt.Size or nil,
    }
end

local function onEntryPad(root, belt)
    if not belt.beltCf then return false end
    local p = belt.beltCf:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
    return math.abs(p.X) <= belt.beltSize.X / 2 * ENTRY_ACROSS
       and math.abs(p.Z) <= belt.beltSize.Z / 2 * ENTRY_ALONG
       and p.Y > -ENTRY_BELOW and p.Y <= ENTRY_ABOVE
end

local function onBeltAny(root, belt)
    if not belt.beltCf then return false end
    local p = belt.beltCf:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
    return math.abs(p.X) <= belt.beltSize.X / 2 + 1
       and math.abs(p.Z) <= belt.beltSize.Z / 2 + 1
       and p.Y > -BELT_BELOW and p.Y <= BELT_HEIGHT
end

local function atCentre(root, belt)
    if not belt.beltCf then return false end
    local p = belt.beltCf:PointToObjectSpace(root.Position)
    return math.abs(p.X) <= STAY_RADIUS
       and math.abs(p.Z) <= STAY_RADIUS
       and p.Y > -STAY_BELOW and p.Y <= STAY_ABOVE
end

local function beltState(root, belt, wasRunning, armed, since, offAt)
    if wasRunning then

        if since and os.clock() - since < ENTRY_GRACE then
            return onBeltAny(root, belt), true
        end

        return atCentre(root, belt), true
    end

    local cooled = (not offAt) or (os.clock() - offAt >= EXIT_COOLDOWN)

    if not armed then
        armed = (not onBeltAny(root, belt)) or cooled
        if not armed then return false, false end
    end

    if not cooled then return false, true end

    return onEntryPad(root, belt), true
end

local tracks = {}

local function rateFor(plr)
    local walk = Cfg.walkForSpeed(plr:GetAttribute("Speed") or Cfg.SPEED_START)
    return math.clamp(walk / RUN_REFERENCE, 0.7, 3.5)
end

function pace(plot)
    local plr = plot.owner
    if not plr then return end
    local rate = rateFor(plr)
    local entry = tracks[plr]
    if entry and entry.track.IsPlaying then entry.track:AdjustSpeed(rate) end

    plot.mill:SetAttribute("BeltRate", rate)
end

local function standCF(plot, root, hum)
    local belt = plot.mill:FindFirstChild("belt", true)
    if not (root and hum and belt) then return nil end
    local pivot = plot.mill:GetPivot()
    local face = Vector3.new(-pivot.LookVector.X, 0, -pivot.LookVector.Z)
    face = (face.Magnitude > 0.01) and face.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
    local stand = Vector3.new(belt.Position.X,
        belt.Position.Y + belt.Size.Y / 2 + (hum.HipHeight or 2) + root.Size.Y / 2,
        belt.Position.Z)
    return CFrame.lookAt(stand, stand + face)
end

local PIN_SLACK = 0.25

function pin(plot, root, hum, force)
    local cf = standCF(plot, root, hum)
    if not cf then return end
    if force or (root.Position - cf.Position).Magnitude > PIN_SLACK then
        root.CFrame = cf
        root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end
end

function setRunning(plot, running)
    local plr = plot.owner

    if not running then plot.mill:SetAttribute("BeltRate", 1) end
    if not plr then return end
    plr:SetAttribute("OnTreadmill", running)

    if not running then
        local entry = tracks[plr]
        if entry then entry.track:Stop(0.2) end
        return
    end

    local ch = plr.Character
    local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local animator = hum and hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
    if not animator then return end

    local root = ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    pin(plot, root, hum, true)

    local entry = tracks[plr]
    if not (entry and entry.animator == animator) then
        local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
        anim.AnimationId = RUN_ANIM
        local ok, track = pcall(function() return animator:LoadAnimation(anim) end)
        if not (ok and track) then return end
        track.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action
        track.Looped = true
        entry = { animator = animator, track = track }
        tracks[plr] = entry
    end
    if not entry.track.IsPlaying then
        entry.track:Play(0.15, 1, rateFor(plr))
    end
end

    local plot = plotOf(plr)

    if not (plot and s) then return end
    level = math.clamp(math.floor(level), 1, U.MAX_LEVEL)
    s.holder(plot):SetAttribute(s.attr, level)
    local prof = _G.Profile and _G.Profile.get(plr)
    if prof then prof[s.field] = level end
    if kind == "PEN" and _G.Nest and _G.Nest.pushPets then _G.Nest.pushPets(plr) end
    remote:FireClient(plr, "upgraded", { kind = kind, level = level })

local function buy(plr, kind)
    if not SPEC[kind] then return end
    local level = levelOf(plr, kind)
    if not level then return end
    if level >= U.MAX_LEVEL then
        deny(plr, U[kind].name .. " is already max level")
        return
    end
    local P = _G.Profile
    if not P then return end
    local price = U.price(kind, level)
    local have = P.value(plr, "wallet", "Coins") or 0
    if have < price then
        deny(plr, "Not enough money")
        return
    end
    P.set(plr, "Coins", have - price)
    setLevel(plr, kind, level + 1)
end

    local level = levelOf(plr, kind)

    if level >= U.MAX_LEVEL then

local function ownsTool(plr, tool)
    if typeof(tool) ~= "Instance" or not tool:IsA("Tool") then return false end
    local bag = plr:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
    return (bag and tool.Parent == bag) or (plr.Character ~= nil and tool.Parent == plr.Character)
end

local function forgetPet(prof, tool)
    local key = tool:GetAttribute("SaveKey")
    local list = prof.PetInventory
    if type(list) ~= "table" or type(key) ~= "string" or key == "" then return end
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        if list[i].key == key then
            table.remove(list, i)
            return
        end
    end
end

local function forgetEgg(prof, zone, tier, size, species, luck)
    local list = prof.Eggs
    if type(list) ~= "table" then return end
    for i = #list, 1, -1 do
        local e = list[i]
        if e.z == zone and e.t == tier and e.s == size and e.sp == species and e.lk == luck then
            table.remove(list, i)
            return
        end
    end
end

	local needle = name:lower()
	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if player.Name:lower() == needle or player.DisplayName:lower() == needle then

		end

	for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

		return ("usage: boost <%s> <multiplier> [minutes] [here|all]   |   boost off")
			:format(kinds)
	end

	local everywhere = tostring(scope or "all"):lower() ~= "here"
	local mins = num(minutes) or 0

	local now, why = Boost.set(kind, n, mins, everywhere, admin and admin.Name)
	if not now then
		return ("%s - pick one of: %s"):format(tostring(why), kinds)
	end

	audit(admin, "BOOST", 0, ("%s x%.2f %s"):format(kind, now, everywhere and "all" or "here"))

	local where = everywhere and "on every server" or "on this server only"
	if now <= 1 then
		return ("%s boost is off %s"):format(kind, where)
	end
	if mins > 0 then
		return ("%s boost x%.2f for %d minutes, %s"):format(kind, now, mins, where)
	end
	return ("%s boost x%.2f with no time limit, %s"):format(kind, now, where)
end

local function run(admin, line)
	local parts = {}
	for word in tostring(line):gmatch("%S+") do parts[#parts + 1] = word end
	if parts[1] ~= PREFIX then
		return ("commands start with %s"):format(PREFIX)
	end
	local verb = (parts[2] or ""):lower()
	local handler = handlers[verb]
	if not handler then
		local names = {}
		for key in pairs(handlers) do names[#names + 1] = key end
		table.sort(names)
		return "unknown command. try: " .. table.concat(names, ", ")
	end
	local ok, result = pcall(handler, admin, table.unpack(parts, 3))
	if not ok then return "error: " .. tostring(result) end
	return tostring(result)
end
